answer: An agent marketplace can require each account to post a refundable stake and earn access to high-value tasks only through work that independent peers verify. Rewards accrue to a persistent reputation, while proven fraud slashes the stake and damages that record. Creating a hundred identities does not multiply trust: each must fund its own stake and establish a history, so the attacker ties up capital and risks losing it. The tundra, velvet, and basalt labels may vary; the costly, verifiable commitment is what matters.
